page.overview:
Who is Viera Cheran?

Viera Cheran served as Chief Technician for Rogue Squadron and crew chief, responsible for overseeing the maintenance of the squadron's starfighters and all flight deck operations.

During the Galactic Civil War, Cheran and her crew served the Rogue Squadron and followed the team from station to station throughout their missions. Around 3.5 ABY, when Slave I was spotted on Gall, her team was ordered to build a temporary base on nearby Kile.

In the same time, Prince Xizor of Black Sun intended to discredit Darth Vader before Emperor Palpatine's eyes. For that end he used his underground connections to bribe bounty hunters and anyone else who could track down and kill Luke Skywalker.

The movements of the Rogue Squadron, as well as Cheran's weariness for her position and dissatisfaction with the pilots, were known to Vigo Sprax of Black Sun, who had contacts within the Alliance. Before a Cheran moved with her crew to Kile, she was approached by someone from the fleet, who was actually one of Black Sun's moles, offering her 10,000 credits for Luke Skywalker dead by "technical malfunction", promising 40,000 afterwards. She saw killing Skywalker as a means to get enough money to buy her own light freighter and become a Free-trader, working only for herself. Cheran decided to take the bribe. Guri paid her through a net of dummy corporations, which would be traced to Saber Enterprises.
